issue.title: Board panics on `g g` in the PR view
issue.description:
Steps: open the board, press `P` for the PR view with no open PRs, press `g` twice.

Actual: the board crashes with `index out of bounds: the len is 0 but the index is 0` from board/src/pr_view.rs.

Expected: `g g` jumps to the first PR, and does nothing when the list is empty. No panic.
